items.source: Note: This method raises UnsupportedOperationException if the RequestEntity was created with a URI template and variables rather than with a URI instance. This is because a URI cannot be created without further input on how to expand template and encode the URI. In such cases, the URI is prepared by the RestTemplate with the help of the UriTemplateHandler it is configured with.
items.translation: 注意： 如果 RequestEntity 是使用 URI 模板和变量创建的，而不是使用 URI 实例创建的，则此方法会抛出UnsupportedOperationException。这是因为如果没有进一步的输入来展开模板并编码 URI，则无法创建 URI。在这种情况下，RestTemplateRestTemplate 会借助其配置的 UriTemplateHandler 来准备 URI。
